notes: Scrapper Clans "Kickjet Deluxe", a hull mount (outward is up): the Kickjet bell and strapped tank plus a rusty stovepipe nozzle with its own small flame where the bracket was, a racing stripe of hazard tape round the bell and more patches; inside the Kickjet core plus a taped spare plate, a second lamp row and a rusty feed pipe. Damaged: the lower tank strap snapped and the tank sags and weeps fuel, the dent is on fire, the stovepipe is bent over and sputtering, sparks in the core. Disabled: the bell broken off its neck, the stovepipe snapped, the tank slid off and split, the core dead. THIS FILE: the INSIDE half (core, power coupling, repair hatch; its top 4px overhang the inner wall face as a flange).
